name: FUTAPT
description: FUTAPT is a housing marketplace built for Nigerian university students — starting with FUTA. It connects verified landlords, agents, and caretakers with students searching for off-campus rooms and bed spaces, replacing agent runaround and ghost listings with verified posters and secure, escrow-style payments.

features.title: Verified posters only
features.body: Every landlord, agent, and caretaker is personally verified before they can list — shown as a visible badge on every listing.

features.title: Escrow-style secure payments
features.body: Funds are held until the student confirms they've moved in, protecting both sides from fraud and off-platform scams.

features.title: Moderated in-app messaging
features.body: Phone numbers, bank details, and external links are auto-blocked before a booking completes — keeping every deal, and its protection, on the platform.

audience.label: Students
audience.desc: Verified rooms and bed spaces near campus — no agent wahala, no ghost listings.

audience.label: Landlords & Agents
audience.desc: List verified properties, reach students directly, and get paid safely through the platform.

audience.label: Caretakers
audience.desc: Post on behalf of landlords, manage inquiries, and track bookings in one place.
